commits.message:
Phase 4: the data views

Graphs: chart modules (palette, line, pie) with WeakMap instance caches,
theme colours from Pico's custom properties and animation off above a few
thousand points; controls bound to the URL query with defaults from design
7.4; stacked line chart (stacking off on negatives), pie chart and summary
table over the same date-filtered subset, with Others marked and an
empty-state message. The summary table renders as an innerHTML swap - one
row per author is far too many for x-for.

Commits: sort, page size and page in the URL (sort and size changes reset
the page), table with dimmed excluded rows and merge icon, expandable
detail row with hash, project, exclude checkbox, plain-text body and a
file table with old rename paths and binary markers. The row stays open
across the rebuild an exclusion triggers.

Config: date basis, merge-commit checkbox with help text, include/exclude
pattern textareas with invalid regexes flagged, the author table with
merge-into datalist and exclude checkboxes (delegated events over an
innerHTML tbody), the excluded-commits list and reset.

Perf against the 16 MB React sample (13,185 commits): series building now
folds into Others before allocating values arrays and maps commits to
buckets with a pointer walk instead of per-commit calendar math, and the
Intl label formatters are cached; group+totals+series is 2-8 ms for every
unit, so a control change re-renders well under the 100 ms target.

Design 13 corrected: the local Alpine sample needs a full clone, not a
blob-less one - git log --numstat fetches every blob lazily otherwise.

Phase 3: upload and persistence

IndexedDB dataset persistence (js/db.js), the non-reactive dataset holder
(js/dataset.js), the config store with localStorage persistence and the
rebuild effect (js/config.js), the real boot sequence with the router guard
reading the dataset, and the upload view: dropzone/file input with a
progress state, shallow validation with inline errors, sample loader,
loaded-data card and clear button, plus the nav summary string.

A copy of the small fixture stands in as samples/smol-gitstat-web.json
until phase 5. Placeholder views for graphs, commits and config so
navigation works before phase 4. Design 7.1/7.3 amended: $store.app gains
sizeBytes and the stored record is { data, sizeBytes }.

Verified in the browser: sample load, reload persistence, clear + guard
redirect, malformed-file errors. The 16 MB React sample: JSON.parse 35 ms,
db.set 47 ms, db.get 46 ms.

Phase 2: compute layer

Types from design 6.2, the hand-written fixture, and the pure compute
modules: time (local-time calendar math, Monday weeks), extend (aliases,
exclusions, rename normalisation, regex filters, filtered totals), group
(author/project/filetype with per-extension splitting), aggregate (the
five aggregations, totals and averages) and series (zero-filled buckets
with Others folding above 2000 points). 48 unit tests, including router
query parsing and DST transitions, run with node --test.

Adds @types/node so tsc understands the node: imports in the tests, and
amends design 12 accordingly.

Benchmark (not committed): extendCommits over old/static/react.json,
13185 commits, best of five runs 48 ms — well under the 1 s target.

Phase 1: application shell

An empty but real application: vendored Alpine, Chart.js and Pico, hash
router with the no-data guard, the x-view directive, boot sequence, nav
with Lucide icons, favicon, about and placeholder upload views, and the
check/lint/fmt tooling.

Design amendments from implementation: exact vendored versions, x-data
on body (Alpine only initialises x-data trees), per-icon CSS classes
(url() in a custom property resolves against the stylesheet), oxfmt's
real exclude syntax, and esModuleInterop plus DOM.Iterable in tsconfig.
